units.source_text: 那嗡嗡的鼻音，弄得男人有些睁不开眼。

en.t: That humming nasal sound made it hard for the man to keep his eyes open.

units.source_text: 女人躬着身子拨弄着小炉子里的火，女人的背影莫名其妙地战战兢兢的，要理解那意思，看来还需费些时间。

en.t: The woman bent over and stirred the fire in the little stove; for some reason her back looked frightened and trembling, and it seemed it would still take some time to understand what that meant.

units.source_text: 就像硬翻开一张发霉的书页那么麻烦。

en.t: It was as troublesome as forcing open a moldy page of a book.
But at least one page had been turned.

units.source_text: 忽然，他觉得自己看上去像个令人可怜的倒霉蛋。

en.t: Suddenly, he felt that he looked like a pitiful unlucky wretch.
